items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: Did you ever work with Bebe? ... Oh, yeah. And that tuxedo, all of them, yeah. Celestat's voice.

ctx.x: Yeah, I didn't see him. I was there at the funeral, but I didn't see him. They had a picture of him in the paper there. And he died about a month, a couple months later, too. Yeah. Did you ever work with Bebe? I guess you did. With Bebe. Bebe Ridgely?
Oh, yeah. And that tuxedo, all of them, yeah. Celestat's voice. Paul Barnes, too. Yeah. Yeah.
What was your very first band then, after you started out?
